samples.name: Simple landing page
samples.purpose: Validate hero, navigation, call-to-action, media, section backgrounds, and footer structure.
failureConditions: Main output is screenshot-only.
Hero title is not editable text.
Primary CTA is not editable.
Major sections are not grouped.

samples.name: Dashboard/settings page
samples.purpose: Validate dense UI reconstruction with sidebar, topbar, settings sections, cards, rows, buttons, and toggles.
failureConditions: Sidebar labels are not editable text.
Settings rows are flattened into one image.
Buttons or toggles are not editable.
Layer hierarchy is too noisy for designer use.

samples.name: Card grid
samples.purpose: Validate repeated card structures with consistent grouping, titles, body text, optional images, and actions.
failureConditions: Repeated cards are not grouped consistently.
Card text is duplicated by parent containers.
Images are missing or flattened into background-only output.
Card order is not stable.

samples.name: Form/input page
samples.purpose: Validate labels, input fields, placeholders, helper text, validation text, and action buttons.
failureConditions: Input fields are only rectangles without labels or placeholders.
Form labels are not editable text.
Primary action button is not editable.
Fields are not grouped under the form container.

samples.name: Navbar + content section
samples.purpose: Validate navigation, structured content, headings, body copy, CTA, and mixed media layout.
failureConditions: Navigation items are not editable text.
CTA is not editable.
Content heading or body copy is missing.
Header and content are not separated into clear sections.
